explanation_en: An intermediate check wins the undefended queen.

intro.popup: 💡 中间招：白车吃b5兵，黑后a3是挂子准备吃白后。白方Rxb5后不应对，先Rb7+将军！
intro.popup_en: 💡 Intermediate move: After the rook captures the b5-pawn, Black's queen on a3 is undefended and can take White's queen. Instead of responding, White can play the intermediate check Rb7+!

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Rxb5吃兵后，黑后Qxa3吃后——白方Rb7+中间将军！Qe7被迫，Rxe7+赢回黑后！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: After Rxb5 and ...Qxa3, White inserts the intermediate check Rb7+. The queen must block with ...Qe7, allowing Rxe7+ to win it back.

moves.popup: 白车Rxb5！吃掉黑兵，同时创造Rb7+将军路线！
moves.popup_en: Rxb5! The rook captures the black pawn and prepares the checking route to b7.

moves.popup: 黑后Qxa3！吃掉白后——但中间将军已准备就绪！
moves.popup_en: Qxa3! Black captures White's queen, but the intermediate check is ready.

moves.popup: 白车Rb7+！中间将军——黑王被迫，黑后必须来挡！
moves.popup_en: Rb7+! An intermediate check forces Black to respond, and the queen must block.

moves.popup: 黑后Qe7——被迫回来拦截将军！
moves.popup_en: The queen is forced back to e7 to block the check.

moves.popup: 白车Rxe7+！吃掉黑后——中间招完成，净赚一后！
moves.popup_en: Rxe7+! White captures the black queen. The intermediate-move tactic is complete, and White has won a queen.
